finding.title: Weak Hash Algorithm
finding.trigger: Using SHA256 for password hashing is considered weak for modern security standards.
finding.assumptions: The code is intended for password hashing, but SHA256 is not recommended for password hashing due to its speed, which makes brute-force attacks more feasible. A stronger algorithm like Argon2, bcrypt, or PBKDF2 should be used.
